summary.text: Bill Bloom is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 64 who has represented the district since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Bloom, whose full name on Ballotpedia is Lewis Bloom, is a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Bill Bloom, listed on Ballotpedia as Lewis Bloom, earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1972, and his career experience includes working as a farmer.
He succeeded Susan Carlson in the District 64 seat and took office on January 9, 2023.
